_comment: WARM-RESUME arm off the GOLDEN 0729 3 h run — 305 sta, GPS+Galileo, 30 s.
First real exercise of the warm-resume path against a WELL-CONVERGED seed, which is
exactly what project_gg305_warm_resume_chain named as the missing prerequisite:
'a longer converge (tighter reference) + >= 60 post-resume epochs'.
WHY IT CANNOT START AT THE GOLDEN'S END.  The golden's last snapshot is ep0303 at
TOW 268260.0 (02:31:00) — the 1800 s interval writer would next have fired at ep0363,
and the run stopped at ep0360, so NO end-of-run snapshot exists.  The carry-validity
horizon is max(pl_max_gap_s, clk_model_max_gap) = 900 s (NetworkRunContext.cpp:410),
but the golden's end (TOW 269970, 03:00:00) is 1710 s past that snapshot — nearly 2x
the horizon.  warmResumeAllowed() would reject it, and under state_snapshot_require
that is a hard error, not a silent cold start.  So the resume MUST re-enter within
WINDOW.  First live epoch TOW 268290 (02:31:30) — 30 s after the snapshot, age 30 s
<< 900 s.  Runs 117 epochs to TOW 271770 (03:30:00), which splits into:
* 268290 -> 269970  (57 ep, 02:31:30-03:00:00)  OVERLAPS the golden ⇒ an in-pair
warm-vs-cold comparison on identical data, the same exe and the same thread count.
This is the comparison the gg305 card could not make against its soft reference.
* 270000 -> 271770  (60 ep, 03:00:30-03:30:00)  NEW data past the golden's end —
the 30 minutes actually requested.
start_offset_hours = 2.5208333333 h = 9075 s.  That is a deliberate HALF-EPOCH
back-off from the 9090 s target (CLAUDE.md: bare boundary values sit on the
double-residue boundary).  The loop skips while (t - anchor) < offset, so 9060 is
skipped and 9090 is the first processed epoch, unambiguously.  Re-processing 9060
would double-count the epoch already folded into the snapshot; the restored
prev_week/prev_tow let the existing D2 q*dt machinery inflate across the true gap.
FINGERPRINT.  Extends the golden config verbatim, so roster+order, datum toggles,
carry q's, clock model, pl knobs, ura and emit channels are byte-identical
(NetworkRunContext.cpp:179-240).  start_offset_hours is NOT in the fingerprint, and
neither is emit_pb_filter_jump_k — both are safe to differ on a resume.
state_snapshot_require: TRUE — mandatory here, and it also closes the one ON-tier
POSTURE gap the golden carried.  Without it a fingerprint/age/parse failure SILENTLY
cold-starts and the arm would be graded as warm while running cold.  The snapshot
this run reads is a COPY: a resume OVERWRITES the file it read, so the immutable
converge artifact stays at runs/golden3h_net305/snap.txt.ep0303.
GRADING.  Discard the first ~5 post-resume epochs (the transient is ~3 ep wide).
n_emitted is RESTORED on resume, so the zero-emit guard is unreachable and exit 0 does
NOT prove work was done — check the emitted count against the epoch count directly.
Judge hourly LEVEL bands, never slopes: on a restored diagonal P the filter is briefly
OVERCONFIDENT and ~ep20 sits a local minimum ~30% below the true floor.
